messages:
maya: Heads up — Finvera SQ + security review call tomorrow 10am PT. Main asks: RBAC change auditability, audit log retention (they want 13 months), tenant-scoped KMS envelopes, pen-test followups, and IR SLA expectations. Putting notes here so we can prepare.
aj: Draft agenda: 1) RBAC change process + export proof 2) Audit log schema + retention proof 3) KMS envelope options (BYOK/HSM) 4) Pen-test triage status 5) IR runbook + metrics (RTO/MTTR).
ben_sec: I can own RBAC section. We have an export script and role-binding snapshots. Will demo `scripts/export_role_bindings.sh`.
ben_sec: ```bash
./scripts/export_role_bindings.sh --tenant=finvera --since=2025-11-01
```
kevin_se: Audit logs: we emit structured JSON events to S3 + optional syslog/Graylog forwarder. Default retention is 12 months today. Customer wants 13 months — small policy change but need infra + legal signoff.
lucy_ops: 12 -> 13 months is doable. Need a config flag and a migration for existing buckets (lifecycle policy update). I'll open an infra ticket.
sarah_sales: They also want a sample SIEM ingest (CEF and JSON) for the event type 'admin_role_change' and one example of exported audit evidence.
aj: Sample event (will share in call):
```json
{
  "event_type": "admin_role_change",
  "timestamp": "2025-12-02T18:12:33Z",
  "actor": "svc-account-deploy",
  "target": "tenant:finvera, role:admin",
  "before": ["read","list"],
  "after": ["read","list","write"],
  "request_id": "req_6b2f...",
  "trace_id": "span_9f3a..."
}
```
ir-bot: Incident Bot: note — last P1 (2025-12-02) handled with runbook v1.2; detection -> mitigation loop documented. Refer to internal run logs: https://internal/runs/789
lucy_ops: Pen-test triage: results back — 6 low, 2 medium. Medium #1: open redirect in onboarding flow (fixed, library bumped). Medium #2: ambiguous privilege escalation edge-case in role inheritance logic — marked for deeper code review. Internal ticket SEC-771.
ben_sec: For RBAC proof we should attach role binding export + diff + commit link. Also provide an automated HMAC'd export for tamper evidence.
maya: KMS question: Finvera asks for tenant-dedicated HSM-backed keys + rotation proof. What do we have across deployment modes?
ben_sec: Hosted: BYOK via customer KMS references in our VPC (envelope wrapping supported). Dedicated/Private: option for HSM-backed CMKs with rotation logs exported. We can produce rotation audit where each rotation event has signed metadata.
kevin_se: We'll need to show key usage audit: decrypt/envelope calls per-tenant + rotation timestamps. That data is in KMS audit topic (we can export a slice).
aj: IR metrics: we can show mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR) for last 4 quarters. Quick stat: P1 MTTR ~ 2h last quarter, detection median ~ 28m. I'll attach charts.
sarah_sales: I'll coordinate a 15-min pre-call with Finvera to align expectations and surface any blocking asks so we don't get blindsided.
lucy_ops: Infra ticket created: INF-4521 — update lifecycle policies + provide sample exports to SIEM. ETA 3 business days.
ben_sec: I'll prepare the short demo + export artifacts and include a short script to verify HMAC on the exported RBAC snapshot.
maya: Action items summary: ben_sec — RBAC export + tamper-evidence demo; lucy_ops — INF-4521 + SIEM sample; aj — IR metrics + runbook excerpt; sarah_sales — pre-call + invite; kevin_se — key usage audit slice. If anyone needs a dry run, meet 9:15am tomorrow in #eng-security-dry-run.
sarah_sales: Invite and pre-read sent to Finvera + internal list.
aj: +1. I'll also cover fallback behavior during key rotations and demo the automatic fallback policy.
ben_sec: :eyes: prepping slides and screenshots now.
lucy_ops: Will drop migration plan and bucket lifecycle diff in this thread later today.
maya: Thanks all — feel free to drop final artifacts here. We'll keep this thread as the canonical prep doc. :thumbsup:
